No detection above 0.25, despite visible damage on the upper lug and left edge. Hypothesis: The damage spans several disconnected mask components and scales. Limited pose/defect examples may leave this appearance uncovered; this is a hypothesis, not an observed internal cause.
Automatically identified error; not individually reviewed. See the five reviewed final-test cases in docs/REPORT.md.

A bent prediction at confidence 0.420 covers only part of the upper-edge defect; IoU is 0.486, below the fixed 0.5 matching cutoff. Hypothesis: The box follows the visually strongest notch but underestimates the annotated extent. This demonstrates why finding a defect-looking region is not sufficient for correct localization.

The red patch is correctly detected as color at confidence 0.878, but two bent boxes and a second color box remain as false positives. Hypothesis: The same high-contrast region triggers multiple class heads. Class-aware NMS intentionally keeps different classes; partial boxes also escape same-class suppression. This is classification and duplicate-counting failure, not a missed red patch.

The dark blue patch beside the inner ring has no prediction above the operating threshold. Hypothesis: The relatively small, dark patch blends into the inner-rim shadow and metallic texture. More representative dark-color flaws and higher-resolution validation are plausible next experiments.
